class CommunicationBus {
  constructor() {
    this.emitter = new EventEmitter();
    this.messageQueue = new Map();
    this.messageHistory = [];
    this.connectedModules = new Set();
    
    this.MESSAGE_TYPES = {
      LEARNING_START: 'learning_start',
      LEARNING_DATA: 'learning_data',
      LEARNING_COMPLETE: 'learning_complete',
      ANALYSIS_START: 'analysis_start',
      ANALYSIS_RESULT: 'analysis_result',
      ANALYSIS_COMPLETE: 'analysis_complete',
      MODULE_REGISTER: 'module_register',
      MODULE_READY: 'module_ready',
      MODULE_ERROR: 'module_error',
      SECURITY_CHECK: 'security_check',
      SECURITY_VALIDATION: 'security_validation',
      SECURITY_ALERT: 'security_alert',
      CONVERSION_START: 'conversion_start',
      CONVERSION_PROGRESS: 'conversion_progress',
      CONVERSION_COMPLETE: 'conversion_complete',
      TRAE_CN_EVENT: 'trae_cn_event',
      WEBHOOK_RECEIVED: 'webhook_received',
      AUTOMATION_TRIGGER: 'automation_trigger'
    };
  }
  
  registerModule(moduleName) {
    this.connectedModules.add(moduleName);
    const message = {
      type: this.MESSAGE_TYPES.MODULE_REGISTER,
      data: { moduleName, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
      source: 'communication_bus',
      target: 'all'
    };
    this.broadcast(message);
    return message;
  }
  
  sendMessage(type, data, source, target) {
    const message = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      type,
      data,
      source,
      target,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      signature: this.signMessage(data)
    };
    this.messageHistory.push(message);
    if (target === 'all') this.broadcast(message);
    else this.emitter.emit(`message:${target}`, message);
    this.logMessage(message);
    return message;
  }
  
  broadcast(message) { this.emitter.emit('message:broadcast', message); }
  subscribe(target, callback) {
    if (target === 'all') this.emitter.on('message:broadcast', callback);
    else this.emitter.on(`message:${target}`, callback);
  }
  
  signMessage(data) { return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex'); }
  
  logMessage(message) {
    const logEntry = { timestamp: message.timestamp, messageId: message.id, type: message.type, source: message.source, target: message.target, dataSize: JSON.stringify(message.data).length };
    fs.ensureDirSync('./logs');
    fs.appendFileSync('./logs/communication.log', JSON.stringify(logEntry) + '\n');
  }
  
  getModuleStatus() { return { connectedModules: Array.from(this.connectedModules), totalMessages: this.messageHistory.length, lastMessage: this.messageHistory[this.messageHistory.length-1] }; }
}

class ResourceCallEngine {
  constructor(bus) { this.bus = bus; this.callResults = new Map(); this.callHistory = []; }
  
  async callDeepSeekFolder(folderPath, depth = 0, maxDepth = 5) {
    const results = [];
    if (depth > maxDepth) return results;
    if (!fs.existsSync(folderPath)) return results;
    const items = fs.readdirSync(folderPath);
    for (const item of items) {
      const fullPath = path.join(folderPath, item);
      const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
      if (stat.isFile()) {
        let content = '', isBinary = false;
        const ext = path.extname(item).toLowerCase();
        if (['.txt','.json','.js','.ts','.py','.md','.html','.css','.csv','.xml','.yaml','.yml'].includes(ext)) {
          try { content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf-8'); } catch(e) { isBinary = true; }
        } else isBinary = true;
        const resultItem = {
          type: 'deepseek_file',
          name: item, path: fullPath, size: stat.size, isBinary,
          contentPreview: isBinary ? '[Binary file]' : content.substring(0, 2000),
          extension: ext, timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        if (ext === '.zip') {
          const extractPath = path.join(CONFIG.storage.temp, `extract_${Date.now()}`);
          await fs.ensureDir(extractPath);
          try {
            const unzip = spawn('unzip', ['-o', fullPath, '-d', extractPath]);
            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              unzip.on('close', (code) => code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error(`unzip failed with code ${code}`)));
            });
            const subResults = await this.callDeepSeekFolder(extractPath, depth + 1, maxDepth);
            results.push(...subResults);
            await fs.remove(extractPath);
          } catch(e) { /* skip if unzip unavailable */ }
        }
        results.push(resultItem);
      } else if (stat.isDirectory() && item !== 'node_modules' && !item.startsWith('.')) {
        const subResults = await this.callDeepSeekFolder(fullPath, depth + 1, maxDepth);
        results.push(...subResults);
      }
    }
    return results;
  }
  
  async callWebPageDynamic(url) {
    try {
      const puppeteer = require('puppeteer');
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: true });
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2', timeout: 15000 });
      const content = await page.content();
      const title = await page.title();
      const links = await page.evaluate(() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a => a.href));
      await browser.close();
      return { type: 'web_resource_dynamic', url, title, links: links.slice(0, 50),
               contentPreview: content.substring(0, 2000), timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    } catch (err) {
      return { type: 'web_resource_dynamic', url, error: err.message };
    }
  }
  
  async callAPIStream(endpoint, method = 'GET', body = null, headers = {}) {
    const options = { method, headers };
    if (body) options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, options);
    if (response.body) {
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      let chunks = [];
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        chunks.push(value);
      }
      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      return { status: response.status, data: text };
    }
    return { status: response.status };
  }
  
  async callDeepSeekFiles(folderPath) {
    return this.callDeepSeekFolder(folderPath);
  }
  
  async callWebResource(url) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const req = https.get(url, (res) => {
        let data = '';
        res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
        res.on('end', () => {
          const result = { type: 'web_resource', url, statusCode: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers, content: data, contentLength: data.length, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
          this.bus.sendMessage('learning_data', result, 'call_engine', 'learning_module');
          resolve(result);
        });
      });
      req.on('error', (error) => resolve({ type: 'web_resource', url, error: error.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }));
      req.setTimeout(30000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve({ type: 'web_resource', url, error: '请求超时', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); });
    });
  }
  
  async callAPI(name, endpoint, apiKey = null) {
    try {
      const result = { type: 'api_call', name, endpoint, called: true, authenticated: !!apiKey, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      this.bus.sendMessage('learning_data', result, 'call_engine', 'learning_module');
      return result;
    } catch(error) { return { type: 'api_call', name, endpoint, error: error.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  }
  
  detectContentType(content) {
    if (content.includes('<html>') || content.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>')) return 'html';
    if (content.trim().startsWith('{') || content.trim().startsWith('[')) try { JSON.parse(content); return 'json'; } catch(e) { return 'text'; }
    if (content.includes('function') || content.includes('const ') || content.includes('let ') || content.includes('var ')) return 'javascript';
    if (content.includes('import ') || content.includes('from ')) return 'es6_module';
    if (content.includes('def ') || content.includes('import ')) return 'python';
    return 'text';
  }
  
  extractPatterns(content) {
    const patterns = [];
    if (/function\(|=>/.test(content)) patterns.push('function_definitions');
    if (/class |interface /.test(content)) patterns.push('class_definitions');
    if (/import |require\(/.test(content)) patterns.push('import_statements');
    if (/export |module\.exports/.test(content)) patterns.push('export_statements');
    if (/https?:\/\//.test(content)) patterns.push('url_references');
    if (/@\w+\.\w+/.test(content)) patterns.push('email_addresses');
    if (/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(content)) patterns.push('date_formats');
    if (/# |## /.test(content)) patterns.push('markdown_headers');
    if (/^- |^\* /.test(content)) patterns.push('list_items');
    return patterns;
  }
}

class LearningEngine {
  constructor(bus) {
    this.bus = bus; this.knowledgeBase = new Map(); this.learnedPatterns = []; this.learningSessions = new Map();
    bus.registerModule('learning_module');
    bus.subscribe('learning_module', (message) => this.handleLearningMessage(message));
  }
  
  async handleLearningMessage(message) {
    switch(message.type) {
      case 'learning_start': await this.startLearningSession(message.data); break;
      case 'learning_data': await this.processLearningData(message.data); break;
      case 'learning_complete': await this.completeLearningSession(message.data); break;
    }
  }
  
  async startLearningSession(data) {
    const sessionId = data.sessionId || crypto.randomUUID();
    this.learningSessions.set(sessionId, { startTime: new Date().toISOString(), dataCount: 0, patterns: [], insights: [] });
    this.bus.sendMessage('module_ready', { module: 'learning', sessionId }, 'learning_module', data.source || 'all');
    return sessionId;
  }
  
  async processLearningData(data) {
    const sessionId = data.sessionId;
    let session = this.learningSessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) { await this.startLearningSession({ sessionId }); session = this.learningSessions.get(sessionId); }
    const analysis = this.analyzeContent(data);
    const patterns = this.extractLearningPatterns(data, analysis);
    const insights = this.generateInsights(data, analysis, patterns);
    const knowledgeId = `knowledge_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8)}`;
    const knowledge = { id: knowledgeId, source: data, analysis, patterns, insights, sessionId, learnedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    this.knowledgeBase.set(knowledgeId, knowledge);
    this.learnedPatterns.push(...patterns);
    session.dataCount++; session.patterns.push(...patterns); session.insights.push(...insights);
    this.bus.sendMessage('analysis_result', { knowledgeId, analysis, patterns, insights }, 'learning_module', 'analysis_module');
    return knowledge;
  }
  
  analyzeContent(data) {
    const analysis = { contentType: data.contentType || 'unknown', size: data.size || 0, complexity: 'low', structure: {}, entities: [] };
    if (data.content) {
      const lines = data.content.split('\n').length, words = data.content.split(/\s+/).length;
      analysis.complexity = (lines>100||words>1000)?'high':(lines>20||words>200)?'medium':'low';
      if (analysis.contentType === 'html') analysis.structure = this.analyzeHTMLStructure(data.content);
      else if (analysis.contentType === 'javascript') analysis.structure = this.analyzeCodeStructure(data.content);
      analysis.entities = this.extractEntities(data.content);
    }
    return analysis;
  }
  
  analyzeHTMLStructure(html) {
    return { hasHead: html.includes('<head'), hasBody: html.includes('<body'), scripts: (html.match(/<script/g)||[]).length, styles: (html.match(/<style/g)||[]).length, links: (html.match(/<a\s+href/g)||[]).length, images: (html.match(/<img/g)||[]).length, forms: (html.match(/<form/g)||[]).length };
  }
  
  analyzeCodeStructure(code) {
    return { functions: (code.match(/function\s+\w+|const\s+\w+\s*=\s*\(|let\s+\w+\s*=\s*\(/g)||[]).length, classes: (code.match(/class\s+\w+/g)||[]).length, imports: (code.match(/import\s+.*from|require\(/g)||[]).length, exports: (code.match(/export\s+|module\.exports/g)||[]).length, comments: (code.match(/\/\/|\/\*|\*/g)||[]).length };
  }
  
  extractEntities(content) {
    const entities = [];
    const urlRegex = /https?:\/\/[^\s"']+/g; const urls = content.match(urlRegex);
    if (urls) urls.forEach(url => entities.push({ type: 'url', value: url }));
    const emailRegex = /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b/g; const emails = content.match(emailRegex);
    if (emails) emails.forEach(email => entities.push({ type: 'email', value: email }));
    const codeRegex = /`{3}([\s\S]*?)`{3}|`([^`]+)`/g; let match;
    while ((match = codeRegex.exec(content)) !== null) entities.push({ type: 'code_snippet', value: match[1]||match[2], length: (match[1]||match[2]).length });
    return entities;
  }
  
  extractLearningPatterns(data, analysis) {
    const patterns = [`content_type:${analysis.contentType}`, `complexity:${analysis.complexity}`];
    if (analysis.structure.scripts > 0) patterns.push('has_javascript');
    if (analysis.structure.forms > 0) patterns.push('has_forms');
    if (analysis.entities.some(e=>e.type==='url')) patterns.push('has_external_links');
    if (data.type === 'deepseek_file') patterns.push('source:deepseek');
    if (data.type === 'web_resource') patterns.push('source:web');
    if (data.type === 'api_call') patterns.push('source:api');
    return patterns;
  }
  
  generateInsights(data, analysis, patterns) {

paths:
  /automation/execute:
    post:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"
      summary: "执行统一自动化处理"
      description: |
        🎯 集成所有自动化功能的统一入口，支持工作流创建与执行、智能插件生成、节点自愈修复、AI数据增强。
        
        📋 支持的操作类型（整合所有原始功能）：
        - workflow_management: 工作流管理（创建/更新/执行/删除）
        - plugin_generation: 插件生成（端到端自动生成+自动注册）
        - node_repair: 节点自愈（全节点批量修复+自动检测）
        - ai_enhancement: AI增强（数据摘要/翻译/分类/提取/生成）
        - data_integration: 数据集成（多源连接同步+状态监控）
        - full_automation: 全自动处理（从需求到完成的完整流程）
        
        ⚙️ 用户可选择性启用各项功能，支持手动确认模式。
      operationId: unifiedAutomationExecute
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationRequest"
            examples:
              workflow_example:
                summary: "工作流自动化示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "创建数据同步工作流，每天凌晨同步数据库数据到数据仓库"
                  operation_type: "workflow_management"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  auto_repair_level: "full"
                  workflow_config:
                    name: "数据同步工作流"
                    description: "每天凌晨同步数据库数据到数据仓库"
                    triggers:
                      - type: "schedule"
                        config:
                          cron: "0 0 * * *"
                    steps:
                      - id: "extract"
                        name: "提取数据"
                        type: "action"
                        action: "database.query"
                        parameters:
                          connection: "prod-db"
                          query: "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1"
              plugin_example:
                summary: "插件生成示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "创建实时股票监控插件：输入股票代码+波动阈值，价格超阈值时发送邮件警报"
                  operation_type: "plugin_generation"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  plugin_config:
                    plugin_name: "股票监控插件"
                    description: "实时监控股票价格并发送警报"
                    auto_register: true
                    input_parameters:
                      - name: "stock_code"
                        type: "string"
                        required: true
                        description: "股票代码"
                      - name: "threshold"
                        type: "number"
                        required: true
                        description: "价格波动阈值"
              repair_example:
                summary: "节点修复示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "检测并修复工作流wf_123中的所有节点问题"
                  operation_type: "node_repair"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  repair_config:
                    workflow_id: "wf_123"
                    repair_scope: "all"
              ai_example:
                summary: "AI增强示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "对销售数据进行智能分析和摘要生成"
                  operation_type: "ai_enhancement"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  ai_config:
                    enhancement_type: "summarize"
                    model_preference: "advanced"
              full_auto_example:
                summary: "全自动插件生成+工作流执行"
                value:
                  user_input: "创建实时股票监控插件：输入股票代码+波动阈值，价格超阈值时发送邮件警报，并自动创建工作流执行"
                  operation_type: "full_automation"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  auto_repair_level: "full"
                  trigger_node_id: "end"
                  plugin_registry: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "自动化执行成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationSuccessResponse"
              examples:
                success_example:
                  summary: "成功响应示例"
                  value:
                    success: true
                    execution_id: "exec_123456789"
                    operation_type: "plugin_generation"
                    results:
                      workflow_result:
                        workflow_id: "wf_789def"
                        status: "created"
                        execution_id: "exec_456ghi"
                        execution_status: "completed"
                      plugin_result:
                        plugin_name: "StockMonitorPlugin"
                        plugin_id: "plugin_123"
                        input_parameters:
                          stock_code: {type: "string", required: true}
                          threshold: {type: "number", required: true}
                        output_parameters:
                          alert_status: {type: "string"}
                          price_data: {type: "object"}
                        coze_import_command: "!plugin import plugin_123"
                        auto_registered: true
                      repair_result:
                        workflow_id: "wf_789def"
                        total_nodes: 15
                        repaired_nodes: 2
                        error_types_fixed: ["invalid_config", "dependency_missing"]
                        success_rate: "100%"
                    summary:
                      total_operations: 5
                      successful_operations: 5
                      execution_time_ms: 4520
                      auto_processing_enabled: true
                    next_actions: ["view_workflow", "download_plugin", "execute_workflow"]
        '400':
          description: "请求参数错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                bad_request_example:
                  value:
                    error:
                      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                      message: "请求参数验证失败"
                      details:
                        - field: "user_input"
                          message: "用户输入不能为空"
                      timestamp: "2023-05-15T10:00:00Z"
        '401':
          description: "未授权访问"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        '500':
          description: "服务器内部错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - CozeApiKey: []

  /automation/status/{execution_id}:
    get:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"
      summary: "获取自动化执行状态"
      description: "查询自动化任务的执行状态和结果"
      operationId: getAutomationStatus
      parameters:
        - name: execution_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: "执行ID"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "状态查询成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationStatusResponse"
        '404':
          description: "执行记录不存在"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []

  /automation/repair/all-nodes:
    post:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"
      summary: "工作流全节点批量自愈"
      description: "自动化检测并修复工作流内所有节点（配置/逻辑/依赖），无需人工干预 - 来自原始节点自愈功能"
      operationId: repairAllNodes
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - workflow_id
              properties:
                workflow_id:
                  type: string
                  description: "需要修复的工作流ID"
                repair_scope:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - "config"
                    - "logic"
                    - "dependency"
                    - "all"
                  default: "all"
                  description: "修复范围（config=配置错误，logic=逻辑错误，dependency=依赖错误）"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "全节点修复成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AllNodeRepairResponse"
        '400':
          description: "请求参数错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      security:
        - CozeApiKey: []

components:
  schemas:
    AutomationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - user_input
        - operation_type
      properties:
        user_input:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          description: "用户输入的需求或指令"
        operation_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "workflow_management"
            - "plugin_generation"
            - "node_repair"
            - "ai_enhancement"
            - "data_integration"
            - "full_automation"
          description: "操作类型"
        enable_auto_processing:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: "是否启用自动化处理"
        auto_repair_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "basic"
            - "advanced"
            - "full"
          default: "full"
          description: "自动化修复级别"
        trigger_node_id:
          type: string
          default: "end"
          description: "触发节点ID（end=结束节点，支持任意节点ID）"
        error_masking_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "none"
            - "partial"
            - "full"
          default: "full"
          description: "错误信息隐藏级别"
        plugin_registry:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: "生成的插件是否自动注册到Coze"
        workflow_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig"
        plugin_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PluginConfig"
        ai_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/AIConfig"
        data_connection_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/DataConnectionConfig"
        repair_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairConfig"

    AutomationSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:

          format: uuid

          type: object
          properties:
            workflow_result:

            plugin_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PluginResult"
            repair_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairResult"
            ai_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AIResult"
            data_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/DataResult"

          properties:

              type: integer

          type: array
          items:
            type: string

      type: object

        execution_id:

          format: uuid

          maximum: 100

        completion_time:

          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowStep"
        outputs:

          items:

          format: uuid

          type: string

      properties:

        plugin_id:

        output_parameters:
          type: object

          type: string

          type: boolean

      type: object
      properties:

        total_nodes:

          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        success_rate:
          type: string
        repair_details:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairDetail"

    AIResult:

      properties:
        enhanced_data:
          type: object
        processing_time:
          type: number
        metadata:
          type: object

      properties:

          format: uuid

          type: string

          type: boolean

          type: string
        parameters:
          type: object
        onSuccess:

          type: string

      properties:

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowStep"
        outputs:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowOutput"

    PluginParameter:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:

        type:
          type: string
          enum: ["string", "number", "boolean", "object", "array"]

          type: string

      type: object
      properties:

        node_type:

          type: string

            repair_details:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                properties:

                    type: string
                  node_type:
                    type: string
                  error_type:
                    type: string
                    enum: ["invalid_config", "logic_error", "dependency_missing", "param_error"]
                  error_detail:
                    type: string
                  repair_action:
                    type: string
                  repair_status:
                    type: string
                    enum: ["success", "failed"]
            repair_statistics:

                  type: integer

                  type: integer
            workflow_available:

        requestId:
          type: string

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:

          properties:

              type: string
            message:
              type: string
            details:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
            timestamp:

              format: date-time

    ApiKeyAuth:

paths:
  /automation/execute:
    post:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"
        - "工作流自动化"
        - "插件生成"
        - "智能触发"
      summary: "执行统一自动化处理"
      description: |
        集成所有自动化功能的统一入口，支持工作流创建与执行、智能插件生成、节点自愈修复、AI数据增强。
        用户可选择性启用各项功能，实现全自动操作体验。
      operationId: unifiedAutomationExecute
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationRequest"
            examples:
              workflow_example:
                summary: "工作流自动化示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "创建数据同步工作流，每天凌晨同步数据库数据到数据仓库"
                  operation_type: "workflow_management"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  auto_repair_level: "full"
                  workflow_config:
                    name: "数据同步工作流"
                    description: "每天凌晨同步数据库数据到数据仓库"
                    triggers:
                      - type: "schedule"
                        config:
                          cron: "0 0 * * *"
              plugin_example:
                summary: "插件生成示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "创建实时股票监控插件：输入股票代码+波动阈值，价格超阈值时发送邮件警报"
                  operation_type: "plugin_generation"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  plugin_config:
                    plugin_name: "股票监控插件"
                    description: "实时监控股票价格并发送警报"
                    auto_register: true
              repair_example:
                summary: "节点修复示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "检测并修复工作流wf_123中的所有节点问题"
                  operation_type: "node_repair"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  repair_config:
                    workflow_id: "wf_123"
                    repair_scope: "all"
              ai_example:
                summary: "AI增强示例"
                value:
                  user_input: "对销售数据进行AI摘要分析"
                  operation_type: "ai_enhancement"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  ai_config:
                    enhancement_type: "summarize"
                    model_preference: "advanced"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "自动化执行成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationSuccessResponse"
        '400':
          description: "请求参数错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        '500':
          description: "服务器内部错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"

        - BearerAuth: []
        - CozeApiKey: []

    post:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"
        - "插件生成"
        - "智能触发"
      summary: "触发全自动插件生成+工作流执行"

            schema:

  /automation/process:
    post:

        - "智能触发"
      summary: "统一智能自动化处理"
      description: "通过单一需求描述自动完成工作流创建、插件生成、执行和修复等完整流程，用户可选择是否启用自动化处理"
      operationId: unifiedAutomationProcess
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - user_requirement
              properties:
                user_requirement:
                  type: string
                  description: "完整的用户需求描述，包含所需功能、工作流程和预期结果的详细说明"
                  example: "创建一个股票监控插件，每天上午9点自动获取指定股票价格，当价格超过设定阈值时发送邮件通知，并生成价格趋势报告"
                enable_auto_processing:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否启用全自动处理模式（默认true，如设为false则会在关键步骤等待用户确认）"
                  default: true
                auto_execute_workflow:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否自动执行创建的工作流（默认true）"
                  default: true
                auto_repair_nodes:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否自动检测并修复问题节点（默认true）"
                  default: true
                notification_preference:
                  type: string
                  description: "处理进度通知偏好"
                  enum:
                    - "silent"
                    - "key_steps"
                    - "detailed"
                  default: "key_steps"
            examples:
              stock_monitoring:
                summary: "股票监控示例"
                value:
                  user_requirement: "创建股票监控自动化流程，监控AAPL、GOOGL股票，当价格波动超过5%时发送短信提醒，并记录到数据库"
                  enable_auto_processing: true
                  auto_execute_workflow: true
                  auto_repair_nodes: true
                  notification_preference: "key_steps"
              data_processing:
                summary: "数据处理示例"
                value:
                  user_requirement: "构建数据ETL流程，从API获取销售数据，进行数据清洗和转换，存储到数据仓库，并生成每日销售报告"
                  enable_auto_processing: false
                  auto_execute_workflow: true
                  auto_repair_nodes: true
                  notification_preference: "detailed"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "自动化处理成功"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success:
                    type: boolean
                  process_id:
                    type: string
                  summary:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      workflow_created:
                        type: boolean
                      plugin_generated:
                        type: boolean
                      workflow_executed:
                        type: boolean
                      nodes_repaired:
                        type: integer
                      total_processing_time:
                        type: number
                  details:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      workflow_info:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          workflow_id:
                            type: string
                          workflow_name:
                            type: string
                          workflow_status:
                            type: string
                          execution_id:
                            type: string
                          execution_status:
                            type: string
                      plugin_info:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          plugin_name:
                            type: string
                          plugin_description:
                            type: string
                          import_command:
                            type: string
                          generated_files:
                            type: array
                            items:
                              type: string
                      repair_report:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          total_nodes_checked:
                            type: integer
                          nodes_repaired:
                            type: integer
                          repair_details:
                            type: array
                            items:
                              type: object
                              properties:
                                node_id:
                                  type: string
                                issue_type:
                                  type: string
                                repair_action:
                                  type: string
                                repair_status:
                                  type: string
                  next_actions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        action:
                          type: string
                        description:
                          type: string
                        endpoint:
                          type: string
        '202':
          description: "处理已接受（当enable_auto_processing=false时）"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  process_id:
                    type: string
                  current_status:
                    type: string
                  pending_approvals:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        step:
                          type: string
                        description:
                          type: string
                        approval_required:
                          type: boolean
                  estimated_completion_time:
                    type: number
        '400':
          description: "请求错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                      suggestion:
                        type: string

  /automation/process/{process_id}/status:
    get:
      tags:
        - "统一自动化工具"

      summary: "获取处理状态"

      operationId: getProcessStatus
      parameters:
        - name: process_id

                      code:
                        type: string

                        type: string

    post:
      tags:

      summary: "批准处理步骤"

      responses:

                    type: string
        '400':
          description: "请求错误"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                      suggestion:
                        type: string
        '404':
          description: "未找到"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        type: string

components:
  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
    CozeApiKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Coze-API-Key

  schemas:
    UnifiedAutomationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - user_input
        - operation_type
      properties:
        user_input:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          description: "用户输入的需求或指令"
        operation_type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "workflow_management"
            - "plugin_generation"
            - "node_repair"
            - "ai_enhancement"
            - "data_integration"
            - "full_automation"
          description: "操作类型"
        enable_auto_processing:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: "是否启用自动化处理"
        auto_repair_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "basic"
            - "advanced"
            - "full"
          default: "full"
          description: "自动化修复级别"
        workflow_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowConfig"
        plugin_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PluginConfig"
        ai_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/AIConfig"
        data_connection_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/DataConnectionConfig"
        repair_config:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairConfig"

    AutomationSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          description: "执行是否成功"
        execution_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: "执行ID"
        operation_type:
          type: string
          description: "执行的操作类型"
        results:
          type: object
          properties:
            workflow_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkflowResult"
            plugin_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PluginResult"
            repair_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RepairResult"
            ai_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AIResult"
            data_result:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/DataResult"
          description: "各项功能执行结果"
        summary:
          type: object
          properties:
            total_operations:
              type: integer
              description: "总操作数量"
            successful_operations:
              type: integer
              description: "成功操作数量"
            execution_time_ms:
              type: integer
              description: "执行时间(毫秒)"
            auto_processing_enabled:
              type: boolean
              description: "是否启用自动化处理"
        next_actions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          description: "建议的下一步操作"

    AutomationStatusResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        execution_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: "执行ID"
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "pending"
            - "running"
            - "completed"
            - "failed"
          description: "执行状态"
        progress:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          description: "执行进度百分比"
        start_time:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: "开始时间"
        completion_time:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: "完成时间"
        results:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/AutomationSuccessResponse"

    AutoPluginTriggerRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - user_demand
      properties:
        user_demand:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          description: "自然语言需求（支持插件生成描述/工作流执行需求）"
          examples:
            - "创建实时股票监控插件：输入股票代码+波动阈值，价格超阈值时发送邮件警报"
            - "基于股票插件生成近7天波动报告并发送到admin@coze.com"
        function_description:
          type: string
          description: "插件功能描述（与user_demand二选一，优先级低于user_demand）"
          examples:
            - "开发用户行为分析插件，输入用户ID和时间范围，输出访问热图和转化率"
        trigger_node_id:
          type: string
          default: "end"
          description: "触发节点ID（end=结束节点，支持任意节点ID，如quantum_plugin_generator）"
        auto_repair_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "basic"
            - "advanced"
            - "full"
          default: "full"
          description: "异常自动修复级别（full=全量自愈）"
        error_masking_level:
          type: string
          enum:
            - "none"
            - "partial"
            - "full"
          default: "full"
          description: "错误信息隐藏级别（full=完全隐藏敏感错误）"
        workflow_id:
          type: string
          description: "自定义工作流ID（可选，未传自动生成）"
        plugin_registry:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: "生成的插件是否自动注册到Coze（true=自动注册）"

    AutoPluginSuccessResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - code
        - message
        - data
        - requestId
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          enum: [0]
        message:
          type: string
          enum: ["success"]
        data:
          type: object
          required:
            - workflow_id
            - execution_id
            - generated_plugin
            - node_repair_summary
          properties:
            workflow_id:
              type: string
            execution_id:
              type: string
            trigger_node_id:
              type: string
            execution_status:
              type: string
              enum:
                - "completed"
                - "running"
            generated_plugin:
              type: object
              required:
                - plugin_name
                - coze_import_command
              properties:
                plugin_name:
                  type: string
                  description: "生成的插件名称（如Auto_StockMonitor）"
                plugin_id:
                  type: string
                  description: "Coze插件ID（自动注册后返回）"
                input_parameters:
                  type: object
                  description: "插件输入参数配置"
                output_parameters:
                  type: object
                  description: "插件输出参数配置"
                coze_import_command:
                  type: string
                  description: "一键导入命令（如!plugin import plugin_123）"
                auto_installed:
                  type: boolean
                  description: "是否已自动安装到Coze"
            node_repair_summary:
              type: object
              properties:
                total_nodes:
                  type: integer
                repaired_nodes:
                  type: integer
                error_types:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                repair_success_rate:
                  type: string
            system_summary:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/SystemSummary"
            operations:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/Operations"
        requestId:
          type: string

    AllNodeRepairRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - workflow_id
      properties:

🛠️ 技术栈描述
API规范：OpenAPI 3.0.3 (符合Coze要求)

认证方式：Bearer JWT + API Key (X-API-Key / X-Coze-API-Key)

数据格式：JSON

通信协议：HTTPS RESTful

核心引擎：

工作流编排引擎（Workflow Engine）

自然语言→插件转换器（Plugin Generator）

智能诊断修复器（Self-Healing Engine）

AI模型集成（AI Enhancement）

多数据源连接池（Data Integration）

部署环境：支持生产、预发布、开发三套环境，以及Coze官方API和Omni-System扩展

📦 功能模块完整列表
模块	描述	关键端点
统一自动化入口	单一入口执行任意自动化操作，用户可开关自动处理	POST /automation/execute
插件生成触发	输入自然语言需求，自动生成并注册Coze插件	POST /automation/trigger
全节点自愈	自动检测修复工作流内所有节点问题	POST /automation/repair/all-nodes
工作流管理	CRUD与执行工作流	GET/POST /workflows, GET/PUT/DELETE /workflows/{id}, POST /workflows/{id}/execute
AI增强	摘要、翻译、分类、提取、生成	POST /ai/enhancements
数据集成	管理数据库、API、文件、消息连接	GET /data/connections
统一流程处理	提供更细粒度的流程控制，含审批机制	POST /automation/process, GET /automation/process/{id}/status, POST /automation/process/{id}/approve
状态查询	查询任何自动化任务的进度	GET /automation/status
🚀 使用指南
1. 导入Coze平台
复制以上完整YAML内容。

在Coze平台创建插件，选择“导入OpenAPI”，粘贴YAML。

系统自动验证，确保无错误后保存。

2. 简单调用示例
bash
复制
下载
# 生成股票监控插件
curl -X POST https://api.coze-automation.com/v1/automation/execute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "user_input": "创建股票监控插件，输入代码和阈值，超阈值发邮件",
    "operation_type": "plugin_generation",
    "enable_auto_processing": true
  }'
3. 全自动模式
将 enable_auto_processing 设为 true，系统将自动完成所有步骤，无需人工干预。

4. 手动模式
设为 false 可在关键步骤（如插件生成确认、工作流执行前）等待用户批准，通过 /automation/process/{id}/approve 进行决策。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
NeuroFactory Fusion 主程序
FastAPI + CLI 双模式入口
"""
import os
import sys
import asyncio
import json
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
import uvicorn
import click
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

from src.core.config_loader import ConfigManager
from src.core.neurofactory import NeuroFactoryFusionSystem
from src.utils.logger import setup_logging

setup_logging(os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

config = ConfigManager("configs/system_config.yaml")
system = None

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    global system
    logger.info("🚀 启动 NeuroFactory Fusion 系统...")
    system = NeuroFactoryFusionSystem(config)
    await system.initialize()
    app.state.system = system
    yield
    await system.cleanup()
    logger.info("🛑 系统已关闭")

app = FastAPI(
    title="NeuroFactory Fusion API",
    version="9.0.0",
    description="全场景智能自动化系统 API",
    lifespan=lifespan
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# 健康检查
@app.get("/health")
async def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "version": "9.0.0"}

# 通用API端点
@app.post("/api/v1/agent/run")
async def run_agent(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    agent_id = data.get("agent_id")
    task = data.get("task")
    if not agent_id or not task:
        raise HTTPException(400, "agent_id and task required")
    result = await system.run_agent(agent_id, task)
    return {"result": result}

@app.post("/api/v1/train")
async def start_training(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    data_path = data.get("data_path", "./data/knowledge")
    result = await system.execute_ai_training({"data_path": data_path})
    return result

@app.post("/api/v1/fix-params")
async def fix_parameters(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    result = await system.fix_parameters(data)
    return result

@app.post("/api/v1/generate-openapi")
async def generate_openapi(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    result = await system.generate_openapi(data)
    return result

@app.post("/api/v1/coze/run")
async def run_coze_workflow(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    workflow_id = data.get("workflow_id")
    params = data.get("params", {})
    result = await system.coze_client.execute_workflow(workflow_id, params)
    return result

@app.post("/api/v1/knowledge/query")
async def query_knowledge(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    question = data.get("question")
    top_k = data.get("top_k", 5)
    result = await system.knowledge_base.query(question, top_k)
    return {"results": result}

@app.post("/api/v1/monetization/arbitrage")
async def run_arbitrage(request: Request):
    data = await request.json()
    threshold = data.get("threshold", 0.05)
    result = await system.money_engine.run_arbitrage(threshold)
    return result

# ==================== CLI 命令 ====================
@click.group()
def cli():
    """NeuroFactory Fusion 命令行工具"""
    pass

@cli.command()
@click.option("--host", default="0.0.0.0", help="绑定地址")
@click.option("--port", default=8000, help="端口")
def serve(host, port):
    """启动 HTTP API 服务"""
    uvicorn.run("src.main:app", host=host, port=port, reload=False)

@cli.command()
@click.argument("command", type=click.Choice(["status", "train", "fix", "openapi", "query"]))
@click.option("--params", default="{}", help="JSON 参数")
def run(command, params):
    """执行后台任务"""
    async def async_run():
        config = ConfigManager("configs/system_config.yaml")
        system = NeuroFactoryFusionSystem(config)
        await system.initialize()
        try:
            if command == "status":
                status = await system.get_system_status()
                print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
            elif command == "train":
                result = await system.execute_ai_training(json.loads(params))
                print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
            elif command == "fix":
                result = await system.fix_parameters(json.loads(params))
                print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
            elif command == "openapi":
                result = await system.generate_openapi(json.loads(params))
                print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
            elif command == "query":
                result = await system.knowledge_base.query(params, top_k=5)
                print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        finally:
            await system.cleanup()
    asyncio.run(async_run())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        cli()
    else:
        uvicorn.run("src.main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

class NeuroFactoryFusionSystem:

    def __init__(self, config: Dict):
        self.config = config
        self.agent = None
        self.coze = None
        self.workflow_engine = None
        self.training = None
        self.feeder = None
        self.fixer = None
        self.openapi = None
        self.security = None
        self.monitor = None
        self.plugins = None
        self.knowledge = None
        self.content = None
        self.money = None
        self.initialized = False

    async def initialize(self):
        """初始化所有子系统"""
        if self.initialized:
            return
        logger.info("初始化 NeuroFactory Fusion...")
        self.agent = HarnessAgent(config=self.config)
        self.coze = CozeClient(config=self.config)
        await self.coze.initialize()
        self.workflow_engine = WorkflowEngine(config=self.config)
        self.training = AITrainingSystem(config=self.config)
        self.training.setup_model()
        self.feeder = QuantumFeeder()
        self.fixer = ParameterFixer()
        self.openapi = OpenAPIManager(config=self.config)
        self.security = QuantumSecurity()
        self.monitor = Monitor(config=self.config)
        self.plugins = PluginRegistry(config=self.config)
        self.knowledge = KnowledgeBase(config=self.config)
        self.content = ContentGenerator(config=self.config)
        self.money = MoneyEngine(config=self.config)
        self.initialized = True
        logger.info("✅ 所有子系统初始化完成")

    async def cleanup(self):
        """清理资源"""
        if self.coze:
            await self.coze.close()
        logger.info("系统已清理")

    # ==================== 核心功能方法 ====================
    async def run_agent(self, agent_id: str, task: Dict) -> Dict:
        """执行 Agent 任务"""
        agent = HarnessAgent(agent_id, self.config.get("manager_url"))
        agent.register()
        agent.start_heartbeat()
        task = agent.pull_task()
        if "error" in task:
            return {"error": task["error"]}
        result = agent.execute_task(task)
        agent.send_result(result)
        agent.stop_heartbeat()
        return {"status": "done", "result": result}

    async def execute_ai_training(self, params: Dict) -> Dict:
        """执行 AI 训练"""
        data_path = params.get("data_path", "./data/knowledge")
        return self.training.train(data_path)

    async def fix_parameters(self, params: Dict) -> Dict:
        """智能参数修复"""
        parameters = params.get("parameters", {})
        api_spec = params.get("api_spec", {})
        return self.fixer.fix(parameters, api_spec)

    async def generate_openapi(self, params: Dict) -> Dict:
        """生成 OpenAPI 规范"""
        endpoints = params.get("endpoints", [])
        info = params.get("info", {})
        spec = self.openapi.generate(endpoints, info)
        return {"spec": spec}

    async def query_knowledge(self, question: str, top_k: int = 5) -> List[Dict]:
        """知识库查询"""
        return self.knowledge.query(question, top_k)

    async def run_arbitrage(self, threshold: float = 0.05) -> Dict:
        """套利交易"""
        return self.money.run_arbitrage(threshold)

    async def generate_content(self, topic: str, content_type: str = "video") -> Dict:
        """内容生成"""
        return self.content.generate(topic, content_type)

    async def get_system_status(self) -> Dict:
        """系统状态"""
        return {
            "initialized": self.initialized,
            "version": "9.0.0",
            "coze_connected": self.coze is not None,
            "model_loaded": self.training.model is not None,
            "knowledge_ready": self.knowledge is not None,
            "active_workflows": len(self.workflow_engine.active_workflows) if self.workflow_engine else 0
        }

#!/bin/bash
# build.sh - 自动化构建脚本

# 1. 环境检查
check_environment() {
    echo "检查系统环境..."
    if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
        echo "错误: Docker未安装"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # 检查磁盘空间
    local free_space=$(df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
    echo "可用磁盘空间: $free_space"
}

# 2. 清理旧构建
clean_previous_build() {
    echo "清理旧构建..."
    docker system prune -f --filter "until=24h"
    rm -rf dist/ node_modules/ .next/
}

# 3. 依赖安装
install_dependencies() {
    echo "安装依赖..."
    
    # 前端项目
    if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
        npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit
    fi
    
    # Java项目
    if [ -f "pom.xml" ]; then
        mvn dependency:go-offline
    fi
    
    # Python项目
    if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
        pip install -r requirements.txt --cache-dir .pip-cache
    fi
}

# 4. 运行测试
run_tests() {
    echo "运行测试..."
    
    # 单元测试
    npm test -- --coverage --passWithNoTests
    
    # 集成测试
    if [ -d "tests/integration" ]; then
        npm run test:integration
    fi
    
    # 生成测试报告
    if [ -f "coverage/lcov.info" ]; then
        bash <(curl -s https://codecov.io/bash)
    fi
}

# 5. 构建应用
build_application() {
    echo "构建应用..."
    
    # 前端构建
    npm run build
    
    # Docker构建
    docker build \
        --build-arg NODE_ENV=production \
        --label "version=${VERSION}" \
        --label "build_date=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" \
        -t ${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION} .
    
    # 多平台构建（如需）
    if command -v docker buildx &> /dev/null; then
        docker buildx create --use
        docker buildx build \
            --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
            -t ${IMAGE_NAME}:${VERSION} \
            --push .
    fi
}

# 主函数
main() {
    check_environment
    clean_previous_build
    install_dependencies
    run_tests
    build_application
}

# 执行
main "$@"

paths:
  /unified-automation:
    post:
      summary: 统一自动化执行端点
      description: |
        单一端点处理所有自动化功能，支持智能路由和自动参数处理
        
        💡 **使用模式选择**：
        - **简单模式**：使用自然语言描述需求，系统自动分析并执行
        - **专业模式**：使用结构化参数精确控制执行流程
        
        🔧 **自动化处理选项**：
        - `enable_automation=true`：系统自动完成参数补全、错误修复、智能路由
        - `enable_automation=false`：严格按照用户输入执行，需完整参数
      tags:
        - 统一智能自动化
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
        - ApiKeyAuth: []
        - CozeAPIKey: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SimpleUserRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProfessionalRequest'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CompleteUnifiedRequest'
            examples:
              简单模式:
                summary: 简单自然语言模式（推荐新手）
                value:
                  user_request: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
                  timeout: 300
                  enable_automation: true
                  preferred_action: "generate_workflow"
              专业模式:
                summary: 专业参数模式（推荐开发者）
                value:
                  operation_type: "generate_workflow"
                  operation_config:
                    workflow_config:
                      business_domain: "ecommerce"
                      complexity_level: "medium"
                      requirement_description: "生成电商订单自动发货工作流"
                    validation_config:
                      auto_validate: true
                      validation_strictness: "standard"
                  async_execution: false
                  version: "v3.0"
                  enable_automation: true
              完整模式:
                summary: 完整智能模式（高级用户）
                value:
                  operation_intent: "分析电商数据并生成智能工作流，自动修复节点问题"
                  operation_config:
                    business_domain: "ecommerce"
                    execution_mode: "auto"
                    priority: "high"
                    resource_allocation:
                      cpu_priority: "high"
                      memory_limit: "2GB"
                      timeout_ms: 60000
                  smart_parameters:
                    auto_detect_plugins: true
                    auto_repair: true
                    error_masking: "partial"
                    validation_strictness: "standard"
                  enable_automation: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 同步操作成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedSuccessResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UnifiedAutomationResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SuccessResponse'
              examples:
                工作流生成成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    execution_time: 2.5
                    result_data:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
                      status: "created"
                    automation_applied: true
                数据处理成功:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_9e3f5d7c2b4a6e8d"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:21:00Z"
                    execution_time: 1.2
                    result:
                      data:
                        processed_items: 1500
                        quality_score: 0.95
                        enhanced_data: {}
                行业分析成功:
                  value:
                    code: 0
                    data:
                      analysis_result: {}
                      recommendations: ["优化供应链", "加强数字化"]
                    message: "行业分析完成"
        '202':
          description: 异步操作已接受
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncOperationResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncAcceptResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AsyncResponse'
              examples:
                异步接受:
                  value:
                    success: true
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "accepted"
                    monitor_url: "https://api.universal-automation.com/v1/operations/op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    estimated_completion: "2025-11-07T14:25:00Z"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
        '400':
          description: 参数验证失败
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithFix'
              examples:
                参数错误:
                  value:
                    code: 4001
                    message: "参数验证失败"
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        value: "生成工作流"
                        suggestion: "请提供更详细的需求描述"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:22:00Z"
                    request_id: "req_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                带修复建议的错误:
                  value:
                    error_code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"
                    error_message: "参数验证失败"
                    fix_suggestions:
                      - "请提供完整的业务领域信息"
                      - "需求描述应至少包含10个字符"
                    auto_fix_applied: false
                    parameter_issues:
                      - parameter_name: "business_domain"
                        issue_type: "missing"
                        current_value: null
                        suggested_fix: "设置为'ecommerce'、'finance'等有效值"
        '500':
          description: 服务器内部错误
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithRecovery'
              examples:
                服务器错误:
                  value:
                    error_code: "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR"
                    error_message: "处理请求时发生内部错误"
                    system_status: "degraded"
                    estimated_recovery_time: 60
                    recovery_actions:
                      - "正在重启受影响的服务"
                      - "检查数据库连接"

  /operations/{operation_id}:
    get:
      summary: 获取操作状态和结果
      description: 查询异步操作的执行状态、进度和最终结果
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      parameters:
        - name: operation_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^op_[a-fA-F0-9]{16}$'
          description: 操作唯一标识符
          example: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 操作状态信息
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OperationStatus'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OperationStatusResponse'
              examples:
                处理中状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "processing"
                    progress: 75
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:22:30Z"
                    estimated_remaining: 45.5
                完成状态:
                  value:
                    operation_id: "op_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                    status: "completed"
                    progress: 100
                    created_at: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    updated_at: "2025-11-07T14:24:00Z"
                    result:
                      workflow_id: "wf_8d7c2b9e1a3f4e5d"
                      workflow_name: "电商订单自动发货流程"
        '404':
          description: 操作不存在
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /health:
    get:
      summary: 系统健康状态检查
      description: 检查系统各组件的健康状态和性能指标
      tags:
        - 系统监控
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 系统健康状态报告
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthCheckResponse'
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SystemStatusReport'
              examples:
                健康状态:
                  value:
                    status: "healthy"
                    timestamp: "2025-11-07T14:20:00Z"
                    uptime: 86400
                    version: "20.0.0-Complete-Unified"
                    components:
                      database: "connected"
                      workflow_engine: "up"
                      ai_services: "up"
                      plugin_system: "up"
                    performance_metrics:
                      response_time: 125
                      throughput: 850
                      error_rate: 0.01
                系统状态报告:
                  value:
                    overall_status: "healthy"
                    component_status:
                      database: "up"
                      cache: "up"
                      queue: "up"
                    performance_metrics:
                      cpu_usage: 45
                      memory_usage: 60
                      disk_usage: 70
                    resource_utilization:
                      total_requests: 10000
                      success_rate: 99.8
                    recommendations:
                      - "建议增加缓存容量"
                      - "数据库连接池可优化"
        '503':
          description: 服务不可用
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponseWithRecovery'

  /validate:
    post:
      summary: 参数验证服务
      description: 验证操作参数的完整性和正确性，提供修复建议
      tags:
        - 参数验证
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 验证结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationResponse'
              examples:

                    auto_fix_applied: false
                验证失败:
                  value:
                    valid: false
                    errors:
                      - field: "parameters.demand"
                        message: "长度需大于10个字符"
                        code: "LENGTH_TOO_SHORT"

                      - field: "parameters.timeout"

                    suggestions: ["请提供更详细的需求描述"]
                    auto_fix_applied: true

components:
  schemas:
    # ==================== 请求对象 ====================
    SimpleUserRequest:
      type: object
      description: 简单用户请求模式 - 使用自然语言描述需求
      properties:
        user_request:
          type: string
          description: 用户自然语言需求描述（系统自动分析并执行）
          minLength: 10
          maxLength: 2000
          example: "帮我创建一个电商订单处理工作流，包含订单确认、库存检查、物流通知功能"
        preferred_action:
          type: string
          description: 用户偏好的功能类型（可选）
          enum:
            - generate_workflow
            - ai_enhancement
            - analyze_industry
            - auto_repair
            - process_luoyang_heritage
          example: generate_workflow
        timeout:
          type: integer
          description: 执行超时时间（10-3600秒）
          default: 300
          minimum: 10
          maximum: 3600
          example: 300
        enable_automation:
          type: boolean
          description: 是否启用自动化处理
          default: true
          example: true
      required:
        - user_request

    ProfessionalRequest:
      type: object
      description: 专业请求模式 - 使用结构化参数精确控制
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UniversalRequest'
        - type: object
          properties:
            enable_automation:
              type: boolean
              description: 是否启用自动化处理
              default: true
              example: true
            timeout:
              type: integer
              description: 执行超时时间（秒）
              default: 300
              minimum: 10
              maximum: 3600

    CompleteUnifiedRequest:
      type: object
      description: 完整统一请求 - 支持智能参数和自动化处理
      properties:
        operation_intent:
          type: string
          description: 操作意图描述
          examples:
            - 分析电商数据并生成智能工作流
            - 修复所有插件节点配置错误
            - 洛阳非遗产品数字化处理和模型训练
          example: "分析电商数据并生成智能工作流"
        operation_config:
          type: object
          description: 操作配置
          properties:
            business_domain:
              type: string
              description: 业务领域
              enum:
                - ecommerce
                - industry
                - finance
                - healthcare
                - education
                - heritage
              example: ecommerce
            execution_mode:
              type: string
              description: 执行模式
              default: auto
              enum:
                - auto
                - manual
                - hybrid
              example: auto
            priority:
              type: string
              description: 优先级
              default: normal
              enum:
                - low
                - normal
                - high
                - critical
              example: high
            resource_allocation:
              type: object
              description: 资源分配配置
              properties:
                cpu_priority:
                  type: string
                  description: CPU优先级
                  default: medium
                  enum:
                    - low
                    - medium
                    - high
                  example: high
                memory_limit:
                  type: string
                  description: 内存限制
                  default: 1GB
                  example: 2GB
                timeout_ms:
                  type: integer
                  description: 超时时间（毫秒）
                  default: 30000
                  example: 60000
        smart_parameters:
          type: object
          description: 智能参数配置
          properties:
            auto_detect_plugins:
              type: boolean
              description: 自动检测插件
              default: true
              example: true
            auto_repair:
              type: boolean
              description: 自动修复
              default: true
              example: true
            error_masking:
              type: string
              description: 错误屏蔽级别
              default: partial
              enum:
                - none
                - partial
                - full
              example: partial
            validation_strictness:
              type: string
              description: 验证严格程度
              default: standard
              enum:
                - relaxed
                - standard
                - strict
              example: standard
        enable_automation:

    ApiKeyAuth:

    NoAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

security:
  - BearerAuth: []

  - CozeAPIKey: []
